paragraph: Granville’s composite reading registers a cautious 44 out of 100, dictating a net-bearish tilt for today's session despite the absence of an active breadth divergence warning. Heavy structural pressure in core market drivers—specifically Semiconductors lagging SPY by -3.44%, Transports down -1.25%, and Risk Appetite off -0.95%—easily overshadows positive equal-weight breadth (+0.83% in RSP/SPY) and neutral defensive rotation (XLP/XLY at +0.48%). Macro metrics present a split picture: a calm VIX at 19.24 sitting in a healthy contango structure (13.3 to 20.5) and stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.79% indicate low systemic panic, but a rising 10-year real yield at 2.43% presents a clear headwind for long-duration assets. Meanwhile, continued outperformance in small caps at 0.3961 and modest credit softness (HYG/LQD down -0.21%) confirm that distribution is concentrated in high-beta tech rather than broad equity liquidation. Expect a choppy, downward-biased session where weakness in semiconductor leadership suppresses index-level gains while resilient underlying breadth keeps the pullbacks orderly.
